 1 package main                                                                                                         
 2                                                                                                                      
 1 import (                                                                                                             
 2     "fmt"                                                                                                            
 3 )                                                                                                                    
 4                                                                                                                      
 5 type GapBuffer struct {                                                                                              
 6     data []rune                                                                                                      
 7     gap  int                                                                                                         
 8     size int                                                                                                         
 9 }                                                                                                                    
10                                                                                                                      
11 func NewGapBuffer(initialSize int) *GapBuffer {                                                                      
12     gb := &GapBuffer{                                                                                                
13         data: make([]rune, initialSize),                                                                             
14         gap:  initialSize,                                                                                           
15         size: 0,                                                                                                     
16     }                                                                                                                
17     return gb                                                                                                        
18 }                                                                                                                    
19                                                                                                                      
20 func (gb *GapBuffer) MoveGap(position int) {                                                                         
21     if position < 0 || position > gb.size {                                                                          
22         return                                                                                                       
23     }                                                                                                                
24     if position < gb.gap {                                                                                           
25         for i := position; i < gb.gap; i++ {                                                                         
26             gb.data[i], gb.data[i+gb.gap-position] = gb.data[i+gb.gap-position], gb.data[i]                          
27         }                                                                                                            
28     } else {                                                                                                         
29         for i := gb.gap; i < position; i++ {                                                                         
30             gb.data[i-gb.gap+position] = gb.data[i]                                                                  
31         }                                                                                                            
32     }                                                                                                                
33     gb.gap = position                                                                                                
34 }                                                                                                                    
35                                                                                                                      
36 func (gb *GapBuffer) Delete(start, end int) {
